integrated_multimodal_description: A clean beauty close-up of a young woman's face, soft natural lighting, neutral background. [Shot 1] From 00:00.000 to 00:01.000 a sweet gentle smile, mouth curving up, eyes forming happy arcs. [Shot 2] From 00:01.000 to 00:02.000 a playful wink, one eye gently closing while the other eyebrow lifts. [Shot 3] From 00:02.000 to 00:03.000 a cute pout, lips slightly pushed out, head tilting a little. [Shot 4] From 00:03.000 to 00:04.000 a surprised look, eyes widening and lips parting slightly. [Shot 5] From 00:04.000 to 00:05.000 a finger heart held beside her cheek with a quick blink. [Shot 6] From 00:05.000 to 00:06.000 a soft closed-eye happy smile, eyes gently shut, peaceful grin, holding still as the scene ends.

overall_soundscape: Soft breath, a tiny giggle on the wink and pout, a light kiss pop on the finger heart, minimal and clean.

non_diegetic_music: A light 6-second cute pop cue with soft chimes, one gentle beat accent per expression change.
